card.line: Iconium was a large, rich city in Lycaonia where Paul and Barnabas preached, many people believed, and the two men fled a plot to stone them.

moments.title: Arriving in Iconium
moments.text: After they were pushed out of their district, Paul and Barnabas shook the dust off their feet and went to Iconium.

moments.title: Preaching in the synagogue
moments.text: Paul and Barnabas went into the Jewish synagogue (a Jewish meeting place) and spoke so well that a great number of Jews and Greeks believed. They stayed a long time and spoke boldly, and the Lord showed that His message of grace was true by giving them power to do signs and wonders.

moments.title: A divided city
moments.text: The people of the city took sides, some with the Jews and others with the apostles. When Jews and Gentiles with their rulers planned to mistreat and stone Paul and Barnabas, the two found out and fled to Lystra and Derbe.

moments.title: Returning to Iconium
moments.text: After preaching in Derbe, Paul and Barnabas went back through Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch. They made the believers stronger and urged them to keep trusting God. They also chose leaders called elders for each church.
